claim_boundary: This protocol evaluates the frozen action-robust correction on the final two previously unscored takes in the 116-take public PokeFlex release. Both physical objects were studied earlier, so this is prospective new-action transfer, not unseen-object generalization or a reconstruction of the five unavailable records in the published validation split.

custody.prediction_frames: all contiguous f from 6 through the last robot frame; active-frame filtering occurs only during locked scoring
custody.registered_source_archive_evidence: canonical opaque-stage manifest binds the registered ZIP hash and every transferred member hash
custody.retry_policy: no replacement; technical failures and exact fallbacks remain in the registered two-take cohort
custody.scored_frames: force-y at f exceeds 3 N, matching the registered official evaluator
custody.target_mesh_access_before_barrier: geometry decoding and scoring forbidden; opaque byte-preserving archive extraction allowed
custody.template_mesh: allowed explicit task input selected by the frozen upstream robot-metadata rule

evaluation.aggregation: equal-weight physical objects over the final two prospectively sealed public takes; frame-level values are diagnostic
evaluation.invalid_jaccard_action: report the failure and valid fraction; never substitute a voxel or repaired-mesh surrogate
evaluation.jaccard_definition: trimesh boolean intersection volume divided by union volume
evaluation.jaccard_role: non-gating reproducibility diagnostic because the released target meshes are not guaranteed volumetric
evaluation.primary_definition: mean nearest-neighbor L1 distance from deterministically sampled predicted surface points to target surface points in original metric coordinates

forbidden: opening a scored deformed mesh before both prediction seals pass the barrier
using frame f Kinect or robot observations to predict frame f
substituting T_WT for missing T_WE or imputing a required actuator pose
changing the multiplier map, metric, aggregation, or gate after target access
replacing either selected take or a technically failed prediction
representing the physical objects as unseen during source development
claiming reproduction of the unavailable published eighteen-take split
combining the final-two prospective result with retrospective actions without labeling the evidence boundary
touching any held-v8 artifact or process

action_robust_advancement.bootstrap_unit: physical object among the final two public takes
action_robust_advancement.reference: frozen global correction scale 0.125 on the same predictions

direct_metric_reference.scope: paired action-robust candidate versus released checkpoint on both prospectively sealed final public takes

paired_transfer.bootstrap_unit: physical object among the final two public takes

method.global_conflict_fallback: multiplier one whenever no non-default multiplier improves both source actions
method.missing_required_robot_pose_action: mark update unsupported and return byte-identical released checkpoint
method.online_selector: none; one two-action maximin multiplier is fixed per object pre-target
method.required_action_history: finite T_WT, T_WE, and force values for every frame used by the frozen action-local field
method.scale_policy: two-action maximin per physical object with frozen capped bank and global fallback
method.state_update: robust correlation-aware graph registration at f-1
method.transfer: one material-vertex-identity step from f-1 to f

official_reference.fresh12_scope: the final two public recordings; only paired checkpoint and global-scale comparisons are authorized
official_reference.paper: PokeFlex: A Real-World Dataset of Deformable Objects for Physics-Based Reconstruction
official_reference.published_split_scope: one hard-coded validation recording per each of eighteen objects

all18_source_extension.note: The target runner remains bound to the earlier v3 calibration. The all-18 extension is source-only corroboration and preserves both rows.

status: pre-outcome lock for repeated-action maximin shrinkage on six third-panel public takes

target_cohort.freshness_scope: exact take outcomes and predictions were unexposed before this lock; the two physical object identities and earlier actions were opened
target_cohort.selection_basis: the exhaustive two-take complement after excluding all 114 public takes exposed by or before the v3 campaign
